description_en: Renews an O\\\&M token for one hour
description_zh: 您可以通过该接口续期运维令牌，单次可将运维令牌续期1小时
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost renew-asset-operation-token --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --token-id NmYyMmEzNmMwYzljNGYxMjh000000 --region cn-hangzhou
